agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider Public Safety Plebiscite motion
agenda_briefs.summary: Vancouver City Council will consider a motion at its August 14, 2026 Special Council meeting to enact a by-law placing two public safety questions on the October 2026 municipal election ballot. The questions ask voters whether the city should strengthen laws to forbid open-air hard drug (Heroin, Meth, Fentanyl, Crack) use in public spaces, and whether the city should ask the Province to convert portions of the old St. Paul's Hospital into a secure medical facility with voluntary and 100-plus involuntary care beds for severe substance use and mental health disorders.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Watch for council's decision at the August 14, 2026 meeting — approval would put these questions on the October 2026 ballot.
